Israa University

📍 Gaza City, Gaza
University Gaza Operational totally demolished

Israa University is a private institution in Gaza City established in the 1990s. It provided undergraduate programmes in business administration, information technology, arts, and legal studies, serving thousands of Gazan students who sought an alternative to the public university system.

Incident history (2)

📅 2024-01-15 Demolition INC-042
After occupying Israa University for 70 days, Israeli forces demolished all remaining campus buildings around 15 Jan, and released footage of the destruction of 17 Jan

January 17 – Video footage emerges of Israeli forces detonating 315 mines to destroy the remaining buildings of Al-Israa University’s Al-Zahara campus, Gaza’s last standing university campus. Israeli soldiers had previously occupied the campus and used it as a military base for 70 days. Al-Israa University had been home to Gaza’s first national museum, containing over 3,000 artifacts, which Israeli forces looted before the demolition.
